Each manager gets a short list of their own accounts to confirm or clean up. The answer stays on record.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Modern organizations run on identities. We help you run them responsibly.
Everyone means every part of the organization, not only the specialists who own it today. Each team sees what it owns, in plain words, and decides.
Employees arrive through HR. The cloud, devices, applications and now agents do not, and agents create their own accounts and access faster than anyone can follow by hand. That is what we build for.
Gartner put Identity Visibility and Intelligence Platforms on its Hype Cycle for Digital Identity: the visibility layer that sits above identity tools rather than beside them. Bsure covers Microsoft only, and goes deeper into it.
Bsure was founded in Norway in 2022, three years before the category had a name.
